name: 泥潭三 / 《終極魔界》 (nitan_san)
english_description: The true 'third generation' release of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine lineage — its login banner literally reads 'once you enter the Mire, it runs as deep as the sea.' Like its close relative nitan_ceshi, it's branded in-game as 'Ultimate Demon Realm,' a skin over the shared nitan engine. Character creation follows the same creation-myth path: choose a name and personality, reroll stats, and be delivered into the world by Pangu at the Valley of Life. It shares its sibling's independence from any external database, though the two branches evolved separately and each carries its own small quirks.
